mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_follow WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_follow (member_id, followee_id, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{followeeId}, NOW(), #{regIp}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, followee_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM member_follow WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.follow_id::TEXT AS row_id, u.handle AS followee_handle, u.nickname AS followee_name, u.profile_file_id::TEXT AS followee_file_id, TO_CHAR(f.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM member_follow f JOIN member u ON u.member_id = f.followee_id AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.status_cd = 'STATUS01' WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY f.follow_id DESC
